Message.Name: System State
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify firms of the state changes of the system. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Pearl system.

Field.Name: CTD Version
Field.Description: Eg: CTD1.0. The CTD Version field value for this release will be CTD1.0. Firms are advised to send CTD1.0 in the SesM Login Request.

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned ID for the current trading session. A change in Session ID will mean that restarting at message sequence number 1.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Pearl trade related content for entitled parties. Pearl sends trades, trade corrections and trade cancels using this message. This is a sequenced message.

Field.Name: Processing Time
Field.Description: Time at which Pearl system (Matching Engine) processed this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Automatic Trades: Time at which the Matching Engine created this trade. Will be same as Processing Time. Manual Trades: Trade Time of the new manual trade. Trades cancels, corrections: Trade Time of the original trade.

Field.Name: Trade As-of Date
Field.Description: As-of Date for As-of Trades. Format: YYYYMMDD. Zero for non As-of Trades.

Field.Name: Trade Action
Field.Description: Note that New trades and Trade Cancel messages can also be generated due to a Clearing changing correction. See Correction Type field for details.

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: Trade Type

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned unique Trade ID for the day. For corrections and cancels, this is the trade ID of the original trade. When used in conjunction with Correction Number, Side and Trade Action, this is a unique identifier for each clearing trade.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Pearl assigned unique Execution ID. Each side of the Clearing trade will have a unique Execution ID.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Used to identify version of the trade being corrected or canceled. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction. While this is 0 for new trades, new trades resulting from corrections may have a non-zero number.

Field.Name: Transaction ID
Field.Description: All clearing trades generated from a single Engine transaction will have the same transaction ID

Field.Name: Reference Trade Time
Field.Description: Time of the parent trade (version of this trade that was active prior to this correction) in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Reference Trade ID
Field.Description: Trade ID of the parent trade in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Reference Correction Number
Field.Description: Correction Number of the parent trade in case of a correction or a new trade generated due to correction. 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: Correction Type
Field.Description: Gives more information to the user when this is a correction.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Pearl Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Underlying Type
Field.Description: Underlying Type

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the trade on which this receiver was involved in.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. This is the corrected trade price if that price changed in a trade correction.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of contract traded in this clearing trade. This is the corrected trade size if that size changed in a trade correction.

Field.Name: Trade condition
Field.Description: See Appendix A for list of possible values. This is the corrected trade condition if that condition changed in a trade correction.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Class Fee Type
Field.Description: Class Fee Type

Field.Name: Pearl BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Pearl

Field.Name: Execution Exchange
Field.Description: Market where a customer order was traded after routing from Pearl

Field.Name: Routed Order Quantity
Field.Description: This contains 0 (zero) for trades at Pearl. For trades resulting from Orders routed to other exchanges, this contains total routed quantity that will be useful in calculating away-exchange block size billing rate.

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Market State

Field.Name: Free Trading Condition
Field.Description: Free Trading Condition

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Executing MPID
Field.Description: For Trades due to FIX Orders: MPID of the EEM/OFP (SenderSubID field in FIX order; Note that this will be different than Clearing MPID for MM FIX orders). For Trades due to Binary Orders: Delivering MPID.

Field.Name: Order Date
Field.Description: For Trades due to FIX Orders: Format: YYYYMMDD. For Binary orders: zero.

Field.Name: FIX Order ID
Field.Description: For Trades due to FIX Orders: Firm assigned Order ID sent via the ClOrdID FIX field. For Trades due to Binary Orders: Spaces.

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Binary Orders: Firm assigned Client Order ID. For Trades due to FIX Orders: zero.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: For Trades due to Binary Orders: Firm assigned Client Message ID of the bulk liquidity message. For Trades due to FIX Orders: zero.

Field.Name: Bulk Liquidity Index
Field.Description: For Trades due to Binary orders: Index assigned by Pearl to each liquidity unit in bulk liquidity message (Index = liquidity unit position in the bulk liquidity message). For Trades due to FIX Orders: zero.

Field.Name: Open/Close Indicator
Field.Description: Open/Close Indicator

Field.Name: Liquidity Type
Field.Description: Pertains to this side.

Field.Name: Liquidity Indicator
Field.Description: Pertains to this side.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: TimeInForce

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Clearing MPID
Field.Description: Clearing MPID of the member

Field.Name: Member Type
Field.Description: Member Type

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Origin

Field.Name: Clearing Number
Field.Description: OCC Clearing number

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: CMTA in case of a give-up trade

Field.Name: Multi Account
Field.Description: Sub or multi account ID specified in order

Field.Name: Account ID
Field.Description: Account ID that is supplied in the order

Field.Name: Supplementary ID
Field.Description: Supplementary ID supplied in the Text field of the FIX order and Additional Text field of MEO orders

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Contra side: MPID of the member

Field.Name: Member Type
Field.Description: Member Type

Field.Name: Origin
Field.Description: Origin

Field.Name: Clearing Number
Field.Description: OCC Clearing number

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: CMTA in case of a give-up trade

Field.Name: ContraTimeInForce
Field.Description: ContraTimeInForce

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Risk Notification Message
Message.Description: Firms configured to use Risk Protection Monitoring will receive User Notification communicating the status of Risk checks. Field Event Type is used to determine the reason for the notification. The following message will be used to disseminate all Pearl Risk Protection Monitor (RPM) related notifications. Sequenced and UnSequenced Pkt based on Event Type: solicited event types (T, R, W, D, A, P, U) are Sequenced messages at the SesM protocol level and recoverable; unsolicited (S) are Unsequenced and not recoverable.

Field.Name: Processing Time
Field.Description: Time at which Pearl system (Matching Engine) processed this notification.

Field.Name: MPID Group ID
Field.Description: Firm Assigned Group ID

Field.Name: Metric ID
Field.Description: Metric ID for the group

Field.Name: Route ID
Field.Description: ID used to route to this session.

Field.Name: Metric Type
Field.Description: Metric Type

Field.Name: Protection Type
Field.Description: Protection Type

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Event Type

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by Pearl for this event. Can be used to order events. Event Type S Event ID will equal zero

Field.Name: Configured Counting Time Period
Field.Description: Configured time period in milliseconds which is used to consider events for this Metric ID

Field.Name: Configured Max Quantity
Field.Description: Configured max threshold of counted items for the Configured Counting Time interval for this Metric ID. Defines rate for the counting time period.

Field.Name: Current Quantity
Field.Description: Current counted quantity at the time of the event for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: Max Peak Quantity
Field.Description: Max peak for Current Quantity during pulse interval

Field.Name: Percentage Level
Field.Description: Current Percentage for the Counted Quantity in relationship to Configured Max Quantity. Valid values from 0 to 255%. Actual percentages greater than 255 will be reported as the max (255)

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Value.Name: Start of Test Session
Value.Description: Start of Test Session (sent before tests).

Value.Name: Manual
Value.Description: Manual trade that Traders requested Pearl personnel to enter

Value.Name: Not Applicable
Value.Description: Not Applicable (Used when message is generated due to a transaction other than Trade corrections)

Value.Name: This side Clearing change
Value.Description: This side Clearing change (Could affect size for Trade splits)

Value.Name: Cancel Of Trade Previously Reported Other Than As The Last Or Opening
Value.Description: Cancel of Trade previously reported other than as the last or opening for the particular Option

Value.Name: Late And Is Out Of Sequence
Value.Description: Trade that is Late and is out of sequence

Value.Name: Cancel Of The Last Reported Trade
Value.Description: Cancel of the last reported Trade for the particular Option

Value.Name: Late And Is In Correct Sequence
Value.Description: Trade that is Late and is in correct sequence

Value.Name: Cancel Of The First Reported Trade
Value.Description: Cancel of the first (opening) reported Trade for the particular Option

Value.Name: Late Report Of The Opening Trade And Is Out Of Sequence
Value.Description: Trade that is late report of the opening trade and is out of sequence

Value.Name: Cancel Of The Only Reported Trade
Value.Description: Cancel of the only reported Trade for the particular Option

Value.Name: Late Report Of The Opening Trade And Is In Correct Sequence
Value.Description: Trade that is late report of the opening trade and is in correct sequence

Value.Name: Reopening Of An Option
Value.Description: Trade due to reopening of an Option in which trading has been previously halted; process as a regular transaction.

Value.Name: Execution Of A Stopped Order
Value.Description: Trade was the execution of an order which was “stopped” at a price that did not constitute a Trade-Through on another market at the time of the stop. Process like a normal transaction except don’t update “last”.

Value.Name: Execution Of An ISO Order
Value.Description: Trade was the execution of an order identified as an Intermarket Sweep Order (ISO).

Value.Name: Trade Through Exempt
Value.Description: Trade that is Trade Through Exempt. The trade should be treated like a regular sale.

Value.Name: Paired PRIME
Value.Description: Trade from a Paired PRIME transaction

Value.Name: PRIME Customer To Customer Cross Or PRIME QCC
Value.Description: Trade from PRIME Customer to Customer Cross or PRIME QCC transaction

Value.Name: Complex Not Stock-Tied No Legging
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex transaction that is not Complex stock-tied and does not involve legging

Value.Name: Complex PRIME Not Stock-Tied No Legging
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex PRIME transaction that is not Complex stock-tied and does not involve legging

Value.Name: Complex PRIME Customer To Customer Cross Or QCC Not Stock-Tied
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex PRIME Customer to Customer Cross or Complex PRIME QCC transaction that is not Complex stock-tied

Value.Name: Complex Legging Not Stock-Tied
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex legging transaction that is not Complex stock-tied

Value.Name: Complex PRIME Stock-Tied No Legging
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex PRIME stock-tied transaction that does not involve legging

Value.Name: Complex PRIME Legging Not Stock-Tied
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex PRIME legging transaction that is not Complex stock-tied

Value.Name: Complex Stock-Tied No Legging
Value.Description: Trade from a Complex stock-tied transaction that does not involve legging

Value.Name: Complex Customer To Customer Cross Or QCC Stock-Tied
Value.Description: Trade from Complex Customer to Customer Cross stock-tied or Complex QCC stock-tied transaction

Value.Name: Not Applicable
Value.Description: ‘ ‘ (space) = Not applicable (for eg: not applicable for manual trades)

Value.Name: Block
Value.Description: Block all MPIDs for this MPID Group ID

Value.Name: Block and Mass Cancel
Value.Description: Block all MPIDs for this MPID Group ID and also mass-cancel all day orders for MPIDs in the group
